column1: # Manifest of the native rule checks. Columns (tab separated): name, source (file in this folder without .cpp), args (- = none), status, note.
# status: ready = must pass against the merged core; pending = needs core work that is not merged yet (skipped unless --pending);

# domain = needs a core tree with the Domain layer applied (skipped unless --pending); stale = expectations that no longer match the merged core (written before the Lua perspective fold, or before F5 opponent binding) (skipped unless --pending; a rewrite is open). One name may have several rows (one process each).
# @DATA@ and @SCRIPTS@ in args are replaced by the card data folder (cards.tsv) and the card script folder.
